source: WHO Weekly Epidemiological Record 1979 Diseases Subject to the Regulations Cholera Notifications
processing_notes: Source confirms zero cholera transmission 1979-04-12..1979-12-31. Source states: 'Areas Removed from the Infected Area List between 6 and 11 April 1979 ... CHOLERA - CHOLERA ... Africa ... ZAMBIA - ZAMBIE Northern Province Kaputa District Mbala District (WER 1979, No. 15); Infected Areas as on 6 December 1979 [cholera, Africa: Burundi, Congo, Ghana, Liberia, Malawi, Mozambique, Nigeria, Sudan, United Rep. of Tanzania, Uganda, Zaire - Zambia not listed] (WER 1979, No. 49); 'The overall number of cases in Africa decreased from 23 317 in 1978 to 18 996 in 1979, due in part to a considerable improvement in the situation in Burundi, Rwanda, the United Republic of Tanzania and Zambia' (WER 1980, No. 18, Cholera in 1979)'. Evidence type: Documented_Absence. Surveillance system status during absence: partial. National zero 12 Apr-31 Dec 1979, bounded by the IHR removal of Zambia's only infected areas (Kaputa and Mbala districts, Northern Province) between 6 and 11 April 1979 and the next notification (telegram of 21 Jan 1980, row 448). Zambia is absent from the complete WHO infected-area lists of 19 Apr, 17 May, 21 Jun and 6 Dec 1979 (WER 1979 Nos. 16, 20, 25, 49; the 6 Dec list verified on the page image) and from every weekly newly-infected list through 17 Jan 1980 (1979 Nos. 36-37, 39-41, 43-44, 47, 51-52 not available in the WHO Library archive). The JHU/WHO 1979 annual (12 cases/11 deaths) and the Kapansa Oct 1978-Dec 1982 aggregates (rows 613-617) span this window, but the 1979 cases fall in Jan-Mar 1979 (8-15 Jan notification, row 446; Kapansa: minor Mpulungu outbreak February 1979, a continuation of the first epidemic) - not a conflict. Surveillance partial: IHR notification functioning (prompt notifications Oct 1978, Jan 1979, Jan 1980) but case detection in remote lake-shore districts limited (Kapansa's Northern total exceeds WHO notifications, i.e. the 1978 first wave was under-notified). Regional context: neighbours in epidemic (Tanzania incl. Rukwa/Mbeya regions, Malawi Karonga, Mozambique, Zaire incl. Shaba) - absence during active regional transmission, so confidence held at 0.6. Reporting date = WER 1980 No. 18 (2 May 1980). National zero - not additive with sub-national rows; do not sum.
